responsibility: This header declares the public entry point for conditional-compare expansion from GIMPLE boolean expressions to RTL. It exposes expand_ccmp_expr so expansion code can ask the CCMP subsystem to turn eligible comparison trees into target-specific compare/ccmp sequences and a final boolean result in a requested machine mode.
same_name_distinction: Provides the minimal interface to the CCMP expander by declaring expand_ccmp_expr; unlike the source file, it does not perform candidate analysis or generate compare/conditional-compare RTL sequences.
